journey.name: Remove background toggle
journey.description: From an empty wardrobe, opens the Add-item sheet and verifies the "Remove background" toggle is correctly gated on a photo being present: it is absent before any photo is chosen and only the photo-source flow is reachable. Start state: fresh install with an empty wardrobe. A fresh install has no photo and no camera/gallery input, so this journey stops at the photo-source dialog — the point where external photo input would be required for the toggle to appear.

actions.action: Verify the Wardrobe screen shows the empty state: the "No items yet" title and an "Add your first item" button.
Tap the "Add your first item" button.
Verify the "Add new item" sheet is shown with a "Tap to add photo" photo area.
Verify that no "Remove background" toggle (add_item_remove_bg_toggle) is shown while no photo has been selected — it must only appear once a photo is present.
Tap the "Tap to add photo" area.
Verify the "Add photo" dialog is shown with "Take photo" and "Choose from gallery" options.
Tap "Cancel" to dismiss the photo dialog.
Verify the "Add new item" sheet is still shown, the "Remove background" toggle is still absent (no photo was selected), and the "Save to wardrobe" button is present.
